source_note: Thematic contexts follow the Edexcel GCSE French (1FR0, 2024) specification. The 2024 spec does not assign sub-topics to contexts; the topics shown are drawn from the spec's shared illustrative subject list and grouped here as expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Describing family and friends shares the same vocabulary of people and relationships
Friendships are the everyday context for talking about relationships
Discussing how people treat one another leads into questions of fairness and equality
Healthy living connects diet and food choices to physical wellbeing
Sport is a core context for talking about keeping fit and healthy
Physical and mental wellbeing are taught together as a healthy lifestyle
Describing the town naturally includes shops and shopping
Getting around the local area links places in town with transport
Awareness of the natural world leads into environmental issues
Transport choices connect directly to pollution and environmental concerns
Social media and streaming are how teenagers discover and share music
Online platforms are a main way young people watch TV and film
School subjects and choices lead into talk about work and the future
Travel vocabulary supports describing trips to tourist attractions
Planning a holiday combines attractions with where to stay
Holiday contexts bring together eating out and accommodation vocabulary
Personal-world topics supply core vocabulary for speaking conversations
Studying and future topics are frequent extended-writing prompts
Environmental issues are common reading-comprehension and translation texts
Media and technology topics feature heavily in listening tasks
